title: refactor(ci): modernize workflows and improve cache parallelism
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Consolidate and modernize CI workflows: split lint/test/release into dedicated jobs, upgrade key GH Actions and Node matrices, and improve cache parallelism to reduce overall build time; no user-facing changes.
description: Motivation: Our repo's CI workflows have accumulated bespoke logic and duplicated steps across lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation. This PR modernizes the workflows by splitting responsibilities into focused pipelines, introducing reusable workflow templates, upgrading several GH Actions (security/hygiene), and improving cache parallelism to reduce wall-clock time for busy branches. Scope: - split existing combined workflow into three top-level pipelines: .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml - introduce .github/workflows/templates/node-build.yml as a reusable template to standardize matrix and caching logic - bump actions/cache, actions/setup-node, and semantic-release actions to latest recommended minor versions - standardize Node matrix to node 18/20 (drop older 16 variants) - improve build cache key strategy and run cache restoration in parallel where safe to reduce cold-cache penalties - add gating and a lightweight integration job to ensure release automation only runs on tagged commits and release branches "This is intended to be a hygiene/refactor change: no runtime code modified, CI-only. Related: ENG-4219 (CI modernize), ENG-4301 (release automation hygiene), SUP-1023 (support flakiness investigation)."
commits: Initial split of combined workflow into lint/test/release (squash of preliminary commits)
Add reusable node-build template and shared cache/key logic
Upgrade GH Actions: actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, semantic-release@21; adjust step signatures
Refine cache keys and parallel restoration steps; add integration smoke job
Address reviewer feedback: reduce matrix size for PRs, add conditional caching for ephemeral jobs
review_comments: Evan: Asked for justification for dropping Node 16 in matrix; noted a couple of third-party integrations still using 16 in infra. Aisha: Confirmed telemetry shows <1% usage for node16, provided rollback instructions and a follow-up ticket to test infra integrations (ENG-4325). Priya: Requested stricter gating for release workflow and that semantic-release step only runs on tagged commits — updated. Marco: Noted flaky integration smoke on macOS runners; added retry and conservative caching to that job. Final status: 2 approvals after addressing requested changes and CI green.
ci_checks: Checks: lint (passed), unit-tests (passed), integration-smoke (flaky on first run, rerun passed), e2e (skipped on PR matrix by default), release-dry-run (passed), security-scan (passed). Total: 6 checks, 1 transient failure rerun. Observed ~18% reduction in median CI wall-time on representative PRs in the branch.
merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2026-02-26 after approvals and green CI. Merge method: squash and merge. Post-merge: created follow-ups ENG-4325 (test infra integrations for node16), ENG-4338 (monitor cache hit rates for 2 weeks).
notes: Deploy impact: none. Ops: Inform platform teams of node matrix changes; rollout plan included a 72-hour monitoring window for flaky jobs. Backouts: revert branch available if we see unexpected CI regression.
